intro: Seat D3-s1, box D3-top6 slice: D3.M3 T1-T3 of the box brief. Run locally on the orchestrator host (Apple M1, 8 cores, 8 GB, macOS), because the cloud fire was refused twice by the frugal guard. The cloud fire before that did PREPARE, R1 and T1 and started the T2 null; the local run re-took the traced baselines and controls, then ran the T2 full gates. T3 (the full net over the 33 owed survivors) moved to three cloud boxes, D3-top6-t3-p1..p3, at the orchestrator's instruction (owner rule: D3 runs on cloud boxes). Their results are collected from handoff-wip/finder-r11-D3-top6-t3-p{1,2,3}. Harness corrections made in this run: tests/card.mjs runs out of memory at node 20.10's default heap on this host, so the gate sets NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=5120 (D3S1_NODE_HEAP). HPO_GATE_LOCK_LABEL is exported, without which stress.py and harness_headers.py wait past their bound for the seat's own lease and are skipped. The worktree is reset by soft reset plus checkout, not --hard, so the finder-wall strip survives. Kills are counted by each script's own 'N of M FAILED' summary against the null. The first null and the fb16/4b37 gates ran with stress.py and harness_headers.py skipped; their KILLED verdicts stand, since a skipped script can only hide a kill. Every wall figure is provisional, on a host shared with other seats (load1 4-250).
